batch.selection: Meta AI 397 份待审母集按冻结顺序排列的第 5 批 60 份资料
batch.admissionRule: 总分至少 6/10，且知识重要性至少 2/3；Cookbook 默认进入补充层

results.title: Hugging Face
results.description: To obtain the models from Hugging Face (HF), sign into your account at huggingface.co/meta-llama. Select the model you want.

scores.rationale: 从 Hugging Face 获取权重属于下载操作。

results.title: Kaggle
results.description: To obtain the models from Kaggle–including the HF versions of the models–sign into your account at kaggle.com/organizations/metaresearch/models.

scores.rationale: 从 Kaggle 获取权重属于下载操作。

results.title: Getting the models
results.description: You can get the Meta Llama models directly from Meta or through Hugging Face or Kaggle.

scores.rationale: 从 Meta 获取权重属于下载操作。

results.title: How-to guides
results.description: Explore Llama's full potential with our comprehensive documentation and resources. Drive developer productivity and innovation.

scores.rationale: How-to guides 是专题导航页。

results.title: Distillation
results.description: Learn how to distill a large language model into a smaller one using synthetic data generation and fine-tuning, and evaluate the distilled model's performance and efficiency. Discover techniques for distillation, including hard features, logit targets, and feature targets, to transfer knowledge from a teacher model to a student model.

scores.rationale: 教师—学生知识迁移、合成数据、logit/feature targets 与效率评测构成完整蒸馏方法。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Fine-tuning》、《Quantization and performance optimization》，本资料的独立增量是：教师—学生知识迁移、合成数据、logit/feature targets 与效率评测构成完整蒸馏方法。

results.title: Fine-tuning
results.description: Learn how to fine-tune Llama models using various methods, including LoRA, QLoRA, and reinforcement learning, to improve performance on specific tasks and adapt to domain-specific knowledge. Fine-tune Llama using libraries like PyTorch's torchtune, Hugging Face peft, Axolotl, and Unsloth.

scores.rationale: LoRA、QLoRA、强化学习与全参数训练的选择覆盖主要领域适配路径。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Distillation》、《Quantization and performance optimization》，本资料的独立增量是：LoRA、QLoRA、强化学习与全参数训练的选择覆盖主要领域适配路径。

results.title: Prompt engineering
results.description: Learn how to improve the performance of large language models through prompt engineering by crafting effective prompts and using techniques such as zero-shot and few-shot prompting, role-based prompts, and retrieval-augmented generation. Discover how to reduce hallucinations and improve model accuracy by providing clear context, instructions, and examples.

scores.rationale: 零样本、少样本、角色提示、RAG 与减少幻觉方法具有广泛基础价值，但并非 Meta 独有。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Llama 3.2》、《Llama 4》，本资料的独立增量是：零样本、少样本、角色提示、RAG 与减少幻觉方法具有广泛基础价值，但并非 Meta 独有。

results.title: Quantization and performance optimization
results.description: Learn how to optimize machine learning models using quantization techniques, such as weight-only, dynamic, and static quantization, and explore various frameworks and tools like PyTorch and Hugging Face to improve model performance and reduce memory usage. Understand the trade-offs between model accuracy, latency, and cost to make informed decisions for your specific use case.

scores.rationale: weight-only、动态和静态量化的精度、延迟、内存与成本权衡是推理优化核心知识。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Distillation》、《Fine-tuning》，本资料的独立增量是：weight-only、动态和静态量化的精度、延迟、内存与成本权衡是推理优化核心知识。

results.title: Developer use guide resources
results.description: We are committed to supporting our community in building Llama applications responsibly. As part of that commitment, we provide this Developer Use Guide that outlines best practices in the context of Responsible GenAI.

scores.rationale: 负责任开发指南资源覆盖设计、数据、安全和部署阶段的风险控制。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Llama 4 Community License Agreement》，本资料的独立增量是：负责任开发指南资源覆盖设计、数据、安全和部署阶段的风险控制。

results.title: Validation
results.description: In this section, we are going to cover different ways to measure and ultimately validate Llama so it's possible to determine the improvements provided by different fine tuning techniques.

scores.rationale: 用任务指标验证微调收益并比较基线，是模型适配闭环不可缺少的评测方法。

results.uniqueDelta: 本批同主题没有可直接替代资料；独立增量是：用任务指标验证微调收益并比较基线，是模型适配闭环不可缺少的评测方法。

results.title: Llama Vision Capabilities
results.description: Llama models can now take Image + Text inputs, enabling you to interact with the model in new ways. Multimodal inputs result in conversations that are more natural and flexible.

scores.rationale: 图文输入、提示格式和多模态交互边界是 Llama 视觉应用的核心依据。

results.uniqueDelta: 本批同主题没有可直接替代资料；独立增量是：图文输入、提示格式和多模态交互边界是 Llama 视觉应用的核心依据。

scores.rationale: Integration guides 是下级框架接入导航。

results.title: LangChain
results.description: LangChain is an open source framework for building LLM powered applications. It implements common abstractions and higher-level APIs to make the app building process easier, so you don't need to call LLM from scratch.

scores.rationale: LangChain 接入步骤高度依赖单一框架，RAG 和 Agent 原理由专门资料覆盖。

results.title: LlamaIndex
results.description: LlamaIndex is another popular open source framework for building LLM applications. Like LangChain, LlamaIndex can also be used to build RAG applications by easily integrating data not built-in the LLM with LLM.

scores.rationale: LlamaIndex 接入步骤高度依赖单一框架，检索原理由专门资料覆盖。

results.title: Llama Everywhere
results.description: Although Meta Llama models are often hosted by Cloud Service Providers, Meta Llama can be used in other contexts as well, such as Linux, the Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL), macOS, Jupyter notebooks, and even mobile devices.

scores.rationale: Llama Everywhere 是操作系统与云运行方式的集合导航。

results.title: Meta Llama in the Cloud
results.description: Apart from running the models locally, one of the most common ways to run Meta Llama models is to run them in the cloud. Let's take a look at some of the other services we can use to host and run Llama models.

scores.rationale: 云端运行资料提供供应方式比较，但平台列表易变化且更完整部署资料已覆盖核心机制。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Llama 4 Acceptable Use Policy》，本资料的独立增量是：云端运行资料提供供应方式比较，但平台列表易变化且更完整部署资料已覆盖核心机制。

results.title: Running Llama on Linux
results.description: With a Linux setup having a GPU with a minimum of 16GB VRAM, you should be able to load the 8B Llama models in fp16 locally. If you have an Nvidia GPU, you can confirm your setup by opening the Terminal and typing nvidia-smi (NVIDIA System Management Interface), which will show you the GPU you have, the VRAM available, and other useful information about your setup.

scores.rationale: Linux 本地安装步骤依赖具体硬件和软件版本，跨环境增量有限。

results.title: Running Llama on Mac
results.description: For this demo, we are using a Macbook Pro running Sonoma 14.4.1 with 64GB memory. Since we will be using Ollamap, this setup can also be used on other operating systems that are supported such as Linux or Windows using similar steps as the ones shown here.

scores.rationale: Mac 本地运行示例依赖特定机器与工具版本。

results.title: Running Llama on Windows
results.description: For this demo, we will be using a Windows OS machine with a RTX 4090 GPU. If you have an Nvidia GPU, you can confirm your setup by opening the Terminal and typing nvidia-smi(NVIDIA System Management Interface), which will show you the GPU you have, the VRAM available, and other useful information about your setup.

scores.rationale: Windows 本地运行示例依赖特定 GPU 与工具版本。

results.title: Llama Models
results.description: To correctly prompt each Llama model, please closely follow the formats described in the following sections.

scores.rationale: 模型卡与提示格式首页主要是子模型导航。

results.title: Introduction
results.description: Llama Guard 3 builds on the capabilities introduced in Llama Guard 2, adding three new categories.

scores.rationale: Llama Guard 3 已被 Guard 4 替代，独立保留价值不足。

results.title: Introduction
results.description: Llama Guard 4 builds on the capabilities introduced in Llama Guard 3 and supports both the Llama 4 and Llama 3 model lines.

scores.rationale: Llama Guard 4 的安全分类、多模态支持和输入输出审查格式是当前护栏模型的核心官方契约。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Llama Prompt Guard 2》、《Llama Protections》，本资料的独立增量是：Llama Guard 4 的安全分类、多模态支持和输入输出审查格式是当前护栏模型的核心官方契约。

results.title: Llama 3.1
results.description: Llama 3.1 - the most capable open model.

scores.rationale: Llama 3.1 模型卡已被新一代模型覆盖，版本特定知识时效较低。

results.title: Llama 3.2

scores.rationale: Llama 3.2 的轻量与视觉模型仍有边缘和多模态选型价值，达到最低保留线。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Prompt engineering》、《Llama 4》，本资料的独立增量是：Llama 3.2 的轻量与视觉模型仍有边缘和多模态选型价值，达到最低保留线。

scores.rationale: Llama 3.3 模型卡被更新模型覆盖，独立增量不足。

results.title: Llama 4
results.description: Technical details and prompt guidance for Llama 4 Maverick and Llama 4 Scout

scores.rationale: Llama 4 Maverick 与 Scout 的架构、能力、上下文和提示格式是当前模型选型主依据。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Prompt engineering》、《Llama 3.2》，本资料的独立增量是：Llama 4 Maverick 与 Scout 的架构、能力、上下文和提示格式是当前模型选型主依据。

results.title: Meta Code Llama
results.description: The instructions prompt template for Meta Code Llama follow the same structure as the Meta Llama 2 chat model, where the system prompt is optional, and the user and assistant messages alternate, always ending with a user message.

scores.rationale: Code Llama 已过时且提示格式由当前编码模型取代。

results.title: Meta Code Llama 70B
results.description: Meta Code Llama 70B has a different prompt template compared to 34B, 13B and 7B. It starts with a Source: system tag—which can have an empty body—and continues with alternating user or assistant values.

scores.rationale: Code Llama 70B 已过时且仅补充旧版本模板。

results.title: Meta Llama 2
results.description: The base model supports text completion, so any incomplete user prompt, without special tags, will prompt the model to complete it.

scores.rationale: Llama 2 模型卡已被后续代际替代。

results.title: Llama 3
results.description: Special Tokens used with Llama 3. A prompt should contain a single system message, can contain multiple alternating user and assistant messages, and always ends with the last user message followed by the assistant header.

scores.rationale: Llama 3 基础格式已被 3.1、3.2、3.3 与 Llama 4 专题替代。

results.title: Meta Llama Guard 1
results.description: Llama Guard was trained in the following categories that can be adapted through prompt engineering.

scores.rationale: 第一代 Llama Guard 已被后续安全模型替代。

results.title: Llama Guard 2
results.description: As the guardrails can be applied both on the input and output of the model, there are two different prompts: one for user input and the other for agent output.

scores.rationale: Llama Guard 2 已被 Guard 3 和 Guard 4 替代。
Other Models 是多种旧模型资料集合，缺乏单一明确知识增量。

results.title: Llama Prompt Guard 2
results.description: LLM-powered applications are susceptible to prompt attacks, which are prompts intentionally designed to subvert the intended behavior of the LLM as specified by the developer.

scores.rationale: Prompt Guard 2 对越狱和提示注入的检测任务、标签及使用边界是代理安全的重要专门机制。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Introduction》、《Llama Protections》，本资料的独立增量是：Prompt Guard 2 对越狱和提示注入的检测任务、标签及使用边界是代理安全的重要专门机制。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Introduction》、《Llama Prompt Guard 2》，本资料的独立增量是：Llama Protections 汇总攻防模型、工具和评测，建立完整安全工具链的架构视图。
